items.Sentence: Wastewater treatment unit operations and processes at the MWRP consist of inline sewage grinding, grinding with augers, primary sedimentation, roughing filtration, biological treatment using activated sludge, secondary clarification, tertiary filtration, and chlorine disinfection.
